The exceptional item of Rs.1,297.08 lakhs as on 31.03.2026 represents an impairment loss on the Company’s investment in Patikari Power Private Limited, an associate. Patikari Power operates a 16 MW hydel power plant on the Beas River in Himachal Pradesh. On 1st July 2025, the plant sustained severe damage following a cloudburst that destroyed major infrastructure, including the approach road, dam site and powerhouse. Management is closely monitoring developments and, after assessing the facts and applying the relevant accounting standards, has recognised an impairment provision and recorded the necessary adjustments in the financial statements.
The exeptional item of Rs. 1,712.00 lakhs as on 30.09.2026 represents differential Anti-Dumping Duty (ADD) liability in Avanti Frozen Foods Pvt. Ltd., pursuant to the revision in ADD rates from 1.35% to 3.76% and 5.53%, respectively, as per the final determinations. The Company has filed an appeal before the CIT, USA. However, considering the materiality of the liability and the uncertainty surrounding the outcome of the legal proceedings, the Management has proposed to recognise a provision of Rs.1,712.00 lakhs and recorded the same in financial statements.
